applyTo: "**/*.md,**/*.mdx,**/*.rst,**/*.adoc,**/docs/**,**/README*"
---

# Documentation and technical writing instructions

- Write for the intended reader and identify prerequisites, supported versions, and expected outcome.
- Keep examples executable and aligned with current source/configuration; label illustrative examples clearly.
- Document risks, permissions, data handling, costs, limitations, and rollback when they matter.
- Never include real credentials, private customer information, or unverified compliance/security claims.
- Update documentation in the same change as user-visible behavior, API, configuration, or operational changes.
